evaluation.rationale: The notes capture most of the important information but fail completely at synthesis. The model lists superseded values, rejected ideas, and resolved questions alongside their final, corrected counterparts, leading to massive internal contradictions. For example, the notes state that Priya will book the cabin and that Dan will book it; that the dates are Oct 16-19 and Oct 23-26; and that the chef and pet issues are unresolved open questions despite being explicitly rejected later in the call. This chronological dumping makes the notes highly confusing, repetitive, and factually unreliable.
